newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINA'S ROBERTS REVEALS PRICE PAID BY HSBC.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINA'S ROBERTS REVEALS PRICE PAID BY HSBC.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc's Latin American unit has paid $633 million to bring its stake in Grupo Roberts to 97.4 percent, the Argentine financial services holding company said Wednesday.
HSBC Latin American BV has also indirectly bought the remainder of the company for an undisclosed amount, Roberts told Argentina's Securities and Exchange Commission.
Before the two transactions, HSBC held 29.9 percent of Banco Roberts, the group's main banking unit.

Keith Whitson, chief executive of Midland Bank and chairman of HSBC's Latin American unit, said last week in Buenos Aires it would pay between $600 million and $700 million for 100 percent of Roberts. The purchase was announced in May.
HSBC has also interests in Brazil, Mexico, Chile and Peru.
